text: no cue: on the wash at shaft power near critical, below the sustainable level, reserve full

arguments.message: pod reserve runs out before the finish at this shaft power

text: no cue: boat-model alert is inflated by the wash; pod shaft power is below critical and the pod reserve is full; watch now reads the pod

arguments.text: Off the pack now. Lift your effort a little and settle.

text: push: off the wash, pod shaft power 179 W is below critical 188 W and sustainable 200 W with the pod reserve full and no fade

arguments.reason: boat reserve read empty for over 3 min with no fade while 10-minute steady boat power held 143 W; pod reserve 97 pct; boat calibration from the test is low

arguments.text: You have plenty left. Lift the effort, hold 2:43 pace.

text: push to 2:43: shaft power stayed 179 W after the first push, below critical 188 W, pod reserve 97 pct; boat critical power revised to 143 W

arguments.text: Current helps this leg. Keep pressing, hold 2:17 pace.

text: push to 2:17: current turning favourable on the new leg, so the old 2:43 target would let the paddler ease; shaft 180 W still below critical 188 W, pod reserve 97 pct

arguments.text: Plenty in reserve. Lift the effort, hold 2:13 this leg.

text: push to 2:13: the 2:17 target was met at 180 W thanks to the current; pod reserve 96 pct and sustainable shaft power 208 W leave room to lift

arguments.text: Into the current now. Dig in harder, hold 2:38.

text: push to 2:38 into the current: shaft 180 W unchanged, pod reserve 96 pct, sustainable 215 W, and effort pays most against the current; replaces the downstream 2:13 target

arguments.message: pod reserve left with 750 m to go: start the finishing sprint

text: no cue: paddler holds 180 W regardless of push cues; finish watch now reads the pod reserve and wakes at 750 m to go for the sprint

arguments.text: Last leg, current helps. Lift to 2:10, sprint soon.

text: push to 2:10 on the final downstream leg: pod reserve 95 pct, sustainable shaft power 248 W, and the old upstream 2:38 target would let the paddler ease

arguments.text: Go now! Sprint all the way to the line.

text: finish: 736 m to go with 94 pct of the pod reserve left and sustainable shaft power 270 W over the remaining distance
